sources.title: KLA FY2026 issuer results
sources.supports: FY2026 revenue $13.58bn and GAAP net income about $4.83bn

sources.title: KLA FY2026 issuer results
sources.supports: Completed-year financial statements and GAAP/non-GAAP reconciliation

financial_anchor.caveat: GAAP after-tax net income governs the hurdle; prior-year operating income is excluded.

ai_claim.claim: KLA describes scoped AI/digital mechanisms in ML defect classification and nuisance reduction, predictive tool service and calibration.
ai_claim.stage: E1; E2 only where management explicitly reports production use
ai_claim.scope: actionable defects found per wafer-hour at fixed false-positive rate, yield learning-cycle time, tool availability and service margin
ai_claim.limitation: No controlled quality-adjusted company result tied to retained incremental cash was found.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: Onto Innovation and fab-built analytics and inspection modules bundled by broader equipment vendors can replicate tools or force gains through to customers.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Competitive capability does not by itself prove equal outcomes.

rights_limit: Customer wafer images and yield correlations are highly confidential. KLA can process data to provide contracted functionality; pooled learning rights are undisclosed and likely contract-specific.
materiality_summary: Five percent of FY2026 GAAP net income is $241.5m on an annual after-tax basis; public evidence does not establish an AI-attributed amount.

arithmetic.inputs: FY2026 GAAP net income $4.83bn; 5%; illustrative eligible pool $1.5bn, efficiency 12%, realization 60%, retention 50%, recurring cost $35m; illustrative tax rate 20%
arithmetic.result: Illustrative $15.2m after tax is below the $241.5m annual after-tax hurdle. The 20% tax rate is an explicit research assumption, not company guidance.

g2_provisional: Open: E1/E2 evidence supports measurement, but E3 quality-adjusted causality and E4 cash retention are not established.
unresolved_questions: What share of eligible workload is in production?
What controlled quality-adjusted KPI result exists?
What do contracts permit for pooled learning and how much benefit is retained after recurring cost?
